about.title: About Al-Munirat Academy
about.description: Founded on the motto of Knowledge, Devotion, and Service, Al-Munirat synthesizes the classical rigor of Al-Azhar and the Two Holy Sanctuaries with modern pedagogical innovation — serving students both on campus and across the globe.
about.historyTitle: A Decade of Sacred Learning, Built to Last Generations
about.historyPara1: Al-Munirat Academy began as a small weekend Qur'an circle and has grown into a global institution serving hundreds of students across our physical campuses and online classrooms. What has never changed is our commitment to an authentic, chain-connected transmission of sacred knowledge — delivered with warmth, structure, and academic rigor.
about.historyPara2: Today our alumni carry Ijazahs in Qira'at, serve as community imams and teachers, and return each year for our pilgrimage programs — a living testament to an education meant to be lived, not just studied.
about.pillarsTitle: Four Pillars of a Complete Islamic Education
about.pillarsDesc: Every course, from the youngest Qur'an memoriser to the graduate Fiqh cohort, is built on these four foundations.
about.pillar1Desc: Systematic memorization with oral chain transmission (Sanad), pristine Tajweed phonetics, and contextual Tafsir delivered by scholars with unbroken chains to the Prophet ﷺ.
about.pillar2Desc: Grammar and syntax (Nahw & Sarf) taught the traditional way, so students engage the Qur'an and Sunnah directly rather than through translation.
about.pillar3Desc: Daily worship, finance, and contemporary ethical questions navigated through mainstream traditional Sunni jurisprudence and its living scholarly tradition.
about.pillar4Desc: Purification of character — humility, Prophetic kindness, civic responsibility, and active service to family and community.
about.leadershipTitle: Governed by Scholars, Run for Students
about.leadership1Desc: A body of Ijazah-holding scholars from the Two Holy Sanctuaries and Al-Azhar oversee curriculum design, Sanad verification, and examination standards each academic term.
about.leadership2Desc: Dedicated male and female instructors serve children, sisters, and brothers separately — in person at our campuses and live online for our global student body.
about.leadership3Desc: A dedicated registry team supports admissions, fee verification, and pastoral care, so every student has a human point of contact throughout their studies.
about.accreditation1: Recognized Ijazah certification with documented Sanad
about.accreditation2: Curriculum benchmarked against Al-Azhar & Haramain syllabi
